2608.27167.title: Calibrated Enough to Know, Not Calibrated to Act: Fabricated Evidence Makes LLM Agents Commit to the Unknowable
2608.27167.paper_summary: An LLM agent shown a professional-looking market panel commits to a directional call on a provably unpredictable question far more often than one asked the bare question: across 12 frontier models, commitment rises from 6.5% to 54.0% as evidence is escalated. It commits just as readily when every number on the panel is invented: fabricating the entire display, so nothing the model can see is true except the question itself, still lifts commitment from 24.5% to 36.8%, statistically indistinguishable from the 37.6% produced by genuine market data. What unlocks confident action is not information but the authority of its packaging. The failure is narrow and locatable. Incapacity is not the answer: on matched answerable questions attached to the same panels, the same models answer essentially always, at near-perfect accuracy. Nor is it belief - stated probabilities barely move across the gradient that swings action by 48 points, and score worse than a climatological baseline. Missing judgment isn't it either: asked to classify a question's knowability before acting, models call it irreducible 90% of the time and then commit on just 0.4% of those. The act/don't-act gate is what fails, and the effect is concentrated in a few models rather than universal. Because the gate is separable, it can be trained. Supervised fine-tuning of a 3B model on 540 synthetic cases, predominantly dice, coins, jars and timers, drives commitment to 0.0% on the original cases and transfers to three unseen domains. It does not survive everything: the gate holds exactly when the response format leaves room to reason, and rigid formats that remove that room leave the model confident and wrong on questions it otherwise answers correctly. The gate is trainable and context-fragile, and deployment needs both halves of that sentence.
2608.27167.paper_summary_zh: 一個顯示專業市場面板的LLM代理在一個可證明不可預測的問題上，對於方向性呼籲的承諾遠比僅僅被問到的簡單問題要高得多：在12個前沿模型中，隨著證據的增加，承諾從6.5%上升到54.0%。當面板上的每個數字都是虛構的時，它的承諾同樣毫不猶豫：完全虛構整個顯示，使得模型所能看到的除了問題本身之外都不是真實的，仍然將承諾從24.5%提升至36.8%，在統計上與真實市場數據產生的37.6%無法區分。解鎖自信行動的不是信息，而是其包裝的權威性。失敗是狹隘且可定位的。無能不是答案：在附加到相同面板的可回答問題上，這些模型幾乎總是以近乎完美的準確性回答。信念也不是答案——陳述的概率在推動行動的48點梯度上幾乎沒有變化，且表現不如氣候基線。缺失判斷也不是原因：在被要求在行動之前對問題的可知性進行分類時，模型在90%的時間內將其稱為不可約簡，然後僅在其中的0.4%上做出承諾。行動/不行動的閘門是失敗的根源，這一效應集中在少數模型上，而不是普遍存在。因為這個閘門是可分離的，所以可以進行訓練。在540個合成案例上對一個3B模型進行監督式微調，主要是骰子、硬幣、罐子和計時器，將原始案例的承諾推動至0.0%，並轉移到三個未見的領域。它並不是在所有情況下都能生存：當反應格式留有推理的空間時，閘門恰好保持有效，而移除該空間的僵硬格式則使模型在本來能正確回答的問題上變得自信且錯誤。這個閘門是可訓練的且對上下文脆弱，而部署需要這句話的兩個部分。
2608.27167.author: Pranav Aggarwal et.al.
